translation:
Koizumi knows a lot about computers, doesn't
he?

Well, I suppose he knows more than you at
least. Why?

He was able to get along with the computer
society president by talking about computers.
They kept using words I didn't understand.

And he was very modest about it, saying that
he only has a passing interest…

You're knowledgeable about making great
tea, Mikuru, so don't worry about it!
